periods.summary: Daniel Dandalion waits on a church roof near the castle wall, correctly predicting that Ikki will choose a route that avoids hurting ordinary citizens. His Device Lionheart can create Blood Circle, a sealed one-on-one duel space, and his flexible rapier techniques counter Ikki's usual sword methods. He studies Ikki in advance and even predicts Saigeki, but Ikki defeats him through a deceptive thrown-Intetsu maneuver using the sword's wrapping cord. Daniel acknowledges that martial skill includes such cunning, concedes defeat, and entrusts Stella to Ikki.

key_events.summary: Duels Ikki on the church roof and loses.

periods.summary: Dandallion helps the royal family during the Quedland crisis and participates in planning how to stop controlled soldiers without killing them. He explains why Fantasy Form would not work on puppeted soldiers because they are not acting through their own consciousness. At Caldia he fights on the west avenue with Stella and is one of the few people Alice considers able to detect relay nodes by experience. Naseem Salim appears and overwhelms him, leaving him bloody and warning Stella not to fight the Desert Reaper.

key_events.summary: Analyzes why nonlethal Fantasy Form attacks will not free puppeted soldiers.
Acts as an experienced relay-node detector on the battlefield.
Is defeated by Naseem and warns Stella to flee.

periods.summary: During Stella's final confrontation with Or-Gaule, Dandelion commands the soldiers forming a circular defensive line between Or-Gaule and the Quedland civilians. He explains that one person cannot withstand Or-Gaule's attacks, but many people supporting each other can; under his direction, soldiers use Devices as shields, stack ranks behind them, and shrink the perimeter to reinforce the line. After the war, Dandelion meets the gravely wounded Tatara at Vermillion International Airport and presents a small auto-piloted jet as payment for her help. When Tatara points out that a League branch director is overlooking aid to a Rebellion assassin, he dryly claims to know only that she is an Akatsuki Academy student. He remains present when Stella destroys the first jet while trying to stop Tatara from leaving.

key_events.summary: Directs the mass shield formation that blocks Or-Gaule's attacks.
Arranges Tatara's jet as compensation and tolerates her departure.
